sources.title: On existence of mini-boson stars
sources.evidence: Proves a countable family of globally regular, spherically symmetric mini-boson-star solutions of the Einstein-Klein-Gordon equations.

sources.title: Quantum fields in boson star spacetime
sources.authors: P. M. Saffin and Q.-X. Xie
sources.evidence: Defines the regular static asymptotically flat quadratic mini-boson-star family, tabulates the source-coordinate member shat(0)=1.2 before the reported maximum-mass point near 1.24, and performs a direct spectral quantum-field/stress calculation on that family. The calculation uses a finite confining sphere and partial Pauli-Villars subtraction; it is a comparator, not a complete Hadamard/RSET/noise proof.

sources.title: A Numerical Study of Boson Stars
sources.evidence: Independent spherical and 3+1 numerical study, including equilibrium, perturbation and evolution benchmarks for ordinary boson stars.

sources.title: Stable Phases of Boson Stars
sources.authors: B. Kleihaus, J. Kunz and S. Schneider
sources.evidence: Identifies the ordinary mini-boson-star stable phase and its turning-point structure.

sources.title: Boson stars driven to the brink of black hole formation
sources.authors: S. H. Hawley and M. W. Choptuik
sources.evidence: Independent dynamical and mode evidence for stable and unstable ordinary boson-star branches around the maximum-mass turning point.

sources.title: Solitonic Boson Stars: Numerical solutions beyond the thin-wall approximation
sources.authors: L. G. Collodel and D. D. Doneva
sources.evidence: Constructs static spherical solitonic boson-star families and documents their numerically stiff thin-wall regime.

sources.title: Stars of bosons and fermions: a comparative study
sources.authors: C. A. R. Herdeiro, A. M. Pombo and E. Radu
sources.evidence: Constructs regular, horizonless, asymptotically flat spherical scalar, Dirac and Proca stars and records the dilute zero-field limit.

sources.title: Numerical evolutions of spherical Proca stars
sources.evidence: Nonlinear spherical evolutions identify a radially stable branch below maximum mass.

sources.title: The non-spherical ground state of Proca stars
sources.authors: C. A. R. Herdeiro et al.
sources.evidence: Finds that spherical fundamental Proca stars can evolve toward prolate configurations under nonspherical dynamics, preventing a full robustness score.

sources.title: Static spherically symmetric perfect fluid solutions with finite radius
sources.evidence: Gives finite- versus infinite-extent criteria for relativistic fluid solutions but does not establish a compact matter profile flat to all orders at a vacuum interface with a globally C-infinity joined metric.

sources.title: Numerical simulation of oscillatons: extracting the radiating tail
sources.authors: P. Grandclément, G. Fodor and P. Forgács
sources.evidence: High-precision spectral work finds a nonzero tail: exact periodic configurations have infinite mass, whereas finite-mass oscillatons radiate and are not static.

sources.title: Adiabatic Vacua and Hadamard States for Scalar Quantum Fields on Curved Spacetime
sources.evidence: Supplies the static ground/KMS Hadamard route once the smooth globally hyperbolic and positive-operator hypotheses are proved.

sources.title: Hadamard renormalization of the stress-energy tensor for a quantized scalar field in a general spacetime of arbitrary dimension
sources.evidence: Defines four-dimensional massive-scalar Hadamard RSET subtraction and finite ambiguity terms.

sources.title: Noise Kernel in Stochastic Gravity and Stress Energy Bi-Tensor of Quantum Fields in Curved Spacetimes
sources.authors: N. G. Phillips and B. L. Hu
sources.evidence: Derives the connected scalar stress-noise bidistribution for general curved spacetimes.

sources.title: Constraint-satisfying initial data for scalar-field spacetimes in the extended conformal flatness condition
sources.evidence: Independent constraint-solving and convergence benchmark for scalar-field/boson-star initial data; useful as a downstream comparator, not a proof of the selected static member.

negative_search_findings: No primary source was found in the bounded queries that completes a Hadamard state, fully renormalized conserved RSET and connected-noise calculation on any candidate family.
The direct 2026 mini-boson-star calculation uses a finite confining sphere and incomplete logarithmic Pauli-Villars subtraction, so it raises Q only to 1 and cannot be imported as proof authority.
No solitonic-, Proca-, or Dirac-star-specific scalar RSET/noise calculation was found in the bounded queries.
No primary source was found that meets the compact-fluid candidate's all-orders matter-flatness and global C-infinity junction requirement.
The oscillaton negative control is nonstatic, and its exact-periodic and finite-mass requirements are incompatible in the cited high-precision tail calculation.
Search absence is not a nonexistence claim; unsupported scores are conservatively lowered as required by the protocol.

candidates.member_selection_rule: Freeze the fundamental nodeless quadratic mini-boson-star member at the source-tabulated central coordinate shat(0)=1.2, encoded exactly as 6/5 for ingress. Do not interpolate, optimize, retune or inspect a new solve. The source reports the maximum-mass point near 1.24, leaving a source-coordinate separation of 0.04 for this pre-turning-point member.

score_reasons.S: The EKG ansatz is exactly static in the metric and its fundamental nodeless soliton is regular everywhere; the complex phase carries no time dependence into the stress tensor.
score_reasons.D: There is no material surface: regular origin and exponentially decaying scalar/metric profiles extend continuously through every finite radius to normalized asymptotically flat infinity.
score_reasons.L: Regular nonvanishing metric functions, horizon absence and flat asymptotics reduce a positive global lapse minimum and spatial completeness to direct bounded duties.
score_reasons.V: The source family has an explicit zero-field dilute limit with ADM mass and metric deformation tending to zero/Minkowski.
score_reasons.K: For the frozen massive minimally coupled real control scalar, the static quadratic form is positive and the positive lapse infimum gives a finite strict mass-gap proof duty.
score_reasons.Q: A direct same-family spectral quantum-field/stress calculation exists, but it is finite-volume and incompletely renormalized and supplies no full noise proof; standard smooth Hadamard/RSET/noise machinery remains required.
score_reasons.P: A one-dimensional analytic-ODE plus interval/radii-polynomial route is bounded, aided by a global existence theorem and surface-free asymptotics.
score_reasons.B: Independent equilibrium, mode, evolution, constraint and quantum calculations expose several source-disjoint comparators.
score_reasons.R: The exact 6/5 source coordinate lies on the reported stable side of the maximum-mass turning point near 31/25 and is separately covered by ordinary mini-boson-star stability studies.
score_reasons.F: A static spherical ODE, compactified exterior and one-dimensional mode decomposition are credible in two disjoint local runtimes.

hard_falsifiers: the ingress member differs from the nodeless quadratic EKG family at shat(0)=6/5
the metric is not one global C-infinity static asymptotically flat geometry
the lapse lacks a strictly positive global lower bound or the spatial slice is incomplete
the scalar has a node, the geometry has a horizon/fold, or any finite-radius interface/distribution is introduced
the branch cannot be continuously connected to Minkowski at zero field
the frozen real-scalar KG operator lacks a positive self-adjoint extension with a strict lower bound
a global static Hadamard ground state, conserved RSET and admissibly smeared connected noise cannot be constructed on the same geometry
the primary and independent implementations cannot be made source/runtime-disjoint
any frozen proof tolerance, grid, arithmetic rule or candidate parameter is changed after observing a result
